conditions: Mandatory weapons and baseline counters have non-missable acquisition paths.
Optional rewards are related to witnessed evidence.
Permanent lockout and recovery rules are declared.
effect: Hidden pages, hunts, recordings, and secrets can improve builds and understanding without turning curiosity into an external-guide requirement.
failure_boundary: If missing a fragment permanently removes the only viable weapon, counter, or main-path completion state, optional discovery has become an undeclared mandatory gate.
